description: The finite agreement consequence has one old-language formula lying between the first conjunction with its relation atom and the implication from the second conjunction to its relation atom.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.separation.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (Γ Δ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Sentence)
  (h :
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side false).onTheory ↑Γ ∪
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side true).onTheory ↑Δ ⊨ᵇ
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.agreement) :
  ∃ ρ,
    (∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubled L n).Structure M]
        [Nonempty M] (a : Fin n → M),
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.finiteConj false Γ ⊓
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.sideAtom false).Realize
            a →
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubleOld.onFormula ρ).Realize a) ∧
      ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubled L n).Structure M]
        [Nonempty M] (a : Fin n → M),
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubleOld.onFormula ρ).Realize a →
          ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.finiteConj true Δ).imp
                (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.sideAtom true)).Realize
            a
